name: billing_amount_migration
goal: Safely migrate billing invoices from amount_cents_legacy to amount_cents without downtime or data loss.

steps.title: Inspect current schema
steps.command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT column_name,data_type,is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='invoices' ORDER BY ordinal_position;"
steps.output:
column_name       | data_type | is_nullable
-------------------+-----------+------------
 amount_cents_legacy | integer   | NO
 status              | text      | NO
steps.verify_command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='invoices' AND column_name='amount_cents_legacy');"

steps.title: Add replacement column
steps.command: psql -d billing -c "ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS amount_cents integer;"
steps.verify_command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT column_name,is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='invoices' AND column_name='amount_cents';"

steps.title: Backfill invoice amounts
steps.command: psql -d billing -c "UPDATE invoices SET amount_cents=amount_cents_legacy WHERE amount_cents IS NULL AND amount_cents_legacy IS NOT NULL;"
steps.verify_command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT count(*) AS remaining FROM invoices WHERE amount_cents IS NULL AND amount_cents_legacy IS NOT NULL;"

steps.title: Validate backfilled values
steps.command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT count(*) AS mismatches FROM invoices WHERE amount_cents IS DISTINCT FROM amount_cents_legacy;"
steps.verify_command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT count(*) AS null_amounts FROM invoices WHERE amount_cents IS NULL;"

steps.title: Enforce replacement constraint
steps.command: psql -d billing -c "ALTER TABLE invoices ALTER COLUMN amount_cents SET NOT NULL;"
steps.verify_command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='invoices' AND column_name='amount_cents';"

steps.title: Swap production column
steps.command: psql -d billing -c "ALTER TABLE invoices RENAME COLUMN amount_cents TO amount_cents_legacy_v2; ALTER TABLE invoices RENAME COLUMN amount_cents_legacy TO amount_cents;"
steps.verify_command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='invoices' AND column_name LIKE 'amount_cents%';"

steps.title: Remove obsolete column
steps.command: psql -d billing -c "ALTER TABLE invoices DROP COLUMN amount_cents_legacy_v2;"
steps.verify_command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='invoices' AND column_name='amount_cents_legacy_v2');"

steps.title: Run final integrity check
steps.command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT count(*) AS invoices, min(amount_cents) AS min_amount, max(amount_cents) AS max_amount FROM invoices;"
steps.verify_command: psql -d billing -c "SELECT count(*) AS invalid_rows FROM invoices WHERE amount_cents IS NULL;"

domain: Postgres schema migration for a billing service (add column, backfill, swap, drop old)

name: prod-db-credential-rotation
goal: Rotate the production orders database credential through Vault, update Kubernetes, restart the application safely, and revoke the previous Vault lease.

steps.title: Check Vault availability
steps.command: vault status -format=json | jq -e '.initialized == true and .sealed == false'

steps.title: Record current Vault lease
steps.command: umask 077; vault list -format=json database/creds/prod-orders | jq -r '.[]' | tail -n 1 > /run/orders-old-lease; echo 'old lease recorded'

steps.title: Mint replacement credential
steps.command: umask 077; vault write -format=json database/creds/prod-orders > /run/orders-new.json; jq -e '.data.username and .data.password' /run/orders-new.json

steps.title: Update Kubernetes secret
steps.command: kubectl create secret generic prod-db-credential --from-literal=username="$(jq -r .data.username /run/orders-new.json)" --from-literal=password="$(jq -r .data.password /run/orders-new.json)" --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
steps.verify_command: kubectl get secret prod-db-credential -o jsonpath='{.data.username}' | base64 -d; echo

steps.title: Restart orders deployment
steps.verify_command: kubectl get deployment orders-api -n production -o jsonpath='{.status.observedGeneration}'

steps.title: Verify application startup
steps.command: kubectl logs deployment/orders-api -n production --since=2m | grep -E 'database credential loaded' | tail -n 1
steps.output: 2026-02-14T09:18:42Z INFO database credential loaded for orders-api
steps.verify_command: kubectl get pods -n production -l app=orders-api -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.phase}'

steps.title: Revoke previous lease
steps.verify_command: vault lease lookup "$(cat /run/orders-old-lease)" 2>/dev/null || echo 'old lease inactive'

domain: rotating a production database credential across Vault, Kubernetes secrets, and app restarts
